snippet.title: Asfalia: The Cranky Volcano on Steam - Trailer
snippet.description:
Play Asfalia: The Cranky Volcano on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1675040/Asfalia_The_Cranky_Volcano/
__________
In this moving and whimsical adventure game, explore Asfalia, a magical world threatened by a volcano. Join Charlie as you meet amazing characters, solve fun puzzles, and collect beautiful stickers along the way! A captivating story-driven game suitable for all ages.

Humor-filled dialogues with cultural references make the story engaging for all ages. Collect hidden stickers, rebuild statues, encounter a hermit dwarf, and help some salmon friends to get their lava river back. 

Inspired by Alice in Wonderland, Inside Out, and The Little Prince, Asfalia blends charm, humor, and heart. With professional English and French voice acting, intuitive controls, and Steam Deck compatibility, it’s perfect for trips or family play. 

Following Asfalia: The Cranky Volcano, there is a second adventure, Asfalia: Panic at the Mansion, expands the enchanting universe with more delightful mysteries. A vibrant, magical journey awaits!
